problems_encountered.problem: Docker安装时dnf代理proxyjp.huawei.com:8080返回407 Proxy Authentication Required
problems_encountered.source: 通过对比环境变量http_proxy(proxyhk)和dnf.conf proxy(proxyjp)发现差异

problems_encountered.problem: 无法从Docker仓库(hub.oepkgs.net, Docker Hub)拉取openEuler镜像，企业网络代理限制
problems_encountered.solution: 使用dnf --installroot从repo.openeuler.org(经proxyhk代理可访问)创建最小openEuler rootfs，通过docker import导入为本地镜像openeuler:24.03-local
problems_encountered.source: 创新方案：利用dnf包管理器可访问的repo.openeuler.org构建rootfs

problems_encountered.problem: 容器中dnf访问HTTPS仓库时SSL证书错误(self-signed certificate in certificate chain)，企业代理SSL拦截
problems_encountered.solution: 在容器中设置sslverify=0(dnf.conf和repo文件)禁用SSL验证
problems_encountered.source: 与git访问gitee.com时的SSL错误相同，企业代理SSL证书拦截

problems_encountered.problem: 清理构建时误删build/源码目录(含CMake模块文件building.cmake/ccache.cmake/utils.cmake)
problems_encountered.solution: 通过git restore build/从版本控制恢复误删的源文件
problems_encountered.source: build/目录在项目中是源码目录(项目脚本)而非构建输出目录，构建输出在dist/release/

problems_encountered.problem: ubturbo_ut链接失败: undefined reference to 'InitLog'
problems_encountered.solution: 未修复。InitLog在src/smap/client/smap_client.cpp:168中是static函数，test_smap_client.cpp用extern声明调用导致链接错误
